The '''Jumurra''' were a [[sentience|sentient]] [[species]] with [[Color|tan]] skin, pointed ears, and brown eyes. They also possessed jowls. During the [[High Republic Era]], the elder [[Naasa]], a member of the species, was in the [[Brendok coven]].<ref name="Destiny" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Jumurra first appeared in "[[Destiny (The Acolyte)|Destiny]],"<ref name="Destiny" /> the third episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 11]], [[2024]], on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The species was first identified in the [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry for Naasa.<ref name="Databank" />
